scenarios.name: One active membership displays server context

steps.text: an authenticated operator with one active organization context
the operator opens the dashboard
the shell displays the active organization name and role
Organization profile navigation is available

scenarios.name: Platform authority does not create organization context

steps.text: an authenticated platform administrator without organization access
the administrator opens the dashboard
no organization identity or profile navigation is displayed
the platform Organizations registry remains available
an authenticated operator requiring organization selection
the operator opens an organization-aware route directly
the page shows Organization selection required
no organization identity is disclosed

scenarios.name: Revocation clears context and profile data

steps.text: an authenticated operator whose organization access will be revoked
the active organization profile is opened and context refreshes
the page shows No organization access
stale organization identity and profile navigation are absent

scenarios.name: A denied profile refresh never flashes cached identity

steps.text: an authenticated operator whose profile request is denied after context loads
the operator opens the denied organization profile
loading hides the cached organization identity
the refreshed page shows No organization access

scenarios.name: Mobile context is accessible without overflow

steps.text: an authenticated operator with one active organization context
the operator opens account navigation at 320 pixels
mobile organization identity and profile navigation are available
the page has no horizontal overflow
an authenticated operator with one active organization context
the operator opens legacy message history
legacy backend requests contain no organization selector
